content.title: Did Team USA baseball win today? Results from game vs. Venezuela
content.text: Eugenio Suarez delivered the decisive blow in the ninth inning, lining a go-ahead RBI double that lifted Venezuela to a 3-2 victory over the United States on Tuesday and secured the team’s first World Baseball Classic championship. Team USA had grabbed the momentum just moments earlier. In the bottom of the eighth, Bobby Witt Jr. worked a two-out walk before Bryce Harper crushed a game-tying two-run home run, sending the crowd at loanDepot Park into a frenzy and briefly reviving the American comeback hopes. The tie lasted only minutes. Luis Arraez opened the top of the ninth with a walk against Garrett Whitlock and pinch runner Javier Sanoja promptly stole second base. Suarez followed by drilling a double into the gap, allowing Sanoja to score easily and restoring Venezuela’s lead for good. Article continues below this adVenezuela had grabbed control early in the game. Maikel Garcia drove in the first run with a sacrifice fly in the third inning, and Wilyer Abreu added a leadoff home run in the fifth to extend the lead to 2-0. The U.S. offense struggled to generate pressure most of the night, managing just three hits. Right-hander Nolan McLean started for Team USA, while Venezuela countered with left-hander Eduardo Rodríguez. Both pitchers were making their second starts of the tournament after uneven earlier outings, but Venezuela’s staff ultimately held the American lineup in check. The loss marked the United States' second consecutive runner-up finish, after falling to Japan in the 2023 final.Article continues below this ad How to watch Team USA baseball vs. Venezuela Tonight's game began at 8 p.m. ET on FOX. Team USA batting order Bobby Witt Jr., SS Bryce Harper, 1B Aaron Judge, RF Kyle Schwarber, DH Alex Bregman, 3B Roman Anthony, LF Will Smith, C Brice Turang, 2B Byron Buxton, CF Article continues below this ad Live updates: Team USA baseball vs. Venezuela Below the photo gallery, the Times Union is providing updates before, during and after tonight's game.Daniel Palencia #29 of Team Venezuela celebrates after the final out of the 3-2 victory was recorded against Team United States at loanDepot park on March 17, 2026 in Miami, Florida. (Photo by Al Bello/Getty Images)Al Bello/Getty Images Final: Venezuela 3, Team USA 2 11:02 p.m.: Daniel Palencia comes into the game and strikes out Kyle Schwarber, gets Gunnar Henderson to pop out, and strikes out Roman Anthony to secure Venezuela's first World Baseball Classic title victory.Article continues below this ad Top 9th: Venezuela 3, Team USA 2 10:49 p.m.: Team USA is down to its final three outs of the game, trailing 3-2. Kyle Schwarber, Gunnar Henderson and Roman Anthony are coming up. Garrett Whitlock exits game 10:45 p.m.: Tyler Rogers replaces Garrett Whitlock with one on and one out in the top of the ninth inning.Article continues below this ad Venezuela retakes the lead 10:38 p.m.: Eugenio Suarez hits a deep fly ball to center field for a double, scoring Sanoja from second base as Venezuela reclaims the lead 3-2 with no outs in the top of the ninth inning. Javier Sanoja steals second base 10:35 p.m.: Luis Arraez draws a leadoff walk in the ninth inning, and Javier Sanoja comes in as a pinch runner. Sanoja steals second base and is called safe. Team USA challenged the decision, but the original call stands, placing a runner in scoring position with no outs. Article continues below this ad Garrett Whitlock replaces Griffin Jax 10:32 p.m.: Garrett Whitlock is on the mound to start the ninth for Team USA. End 8th: Team USA 2, Venezuela 2 10:28 p.m.: Just when it looked like Team USA had thrown in the towel, Bryce Harper says, "Not so fast." A two-run homer deep to center field to save Team USA should quiet the haters for a few days, Bryce.Article continues below this ad Bryce Harper homers to tie it up 10:26 p.m.: Bryce Harper launches a two-run homer to deep center and this game is tied 2-2. Bobby Witt Jr. walks 10:24 p.m.: Bobby Witt Jr. works a two-out walk to bring Bryce Harper to the plate.Article continues below this ad Top 8th: Griffin Jax retires side 10:19 p.m.: Griffin Jax replaces Will Vest to start the eighth and retires the side on eight pitches. We head to the bottom of the eighth. End 7th: Venezuela 2, Team USA 0 10:15 p.m.: Will Smith pops out to second to end the seventh inning. We head to the top of the eighth with Venezuela leading Team USA 2-0.Article continues below this ad Andrés Machado replaces Angel Zerpa 10:11 p.m.: After Roman Anthony works a two-out walk, Andrés Machado comes on to replace Angel Zerpa on the mound for Venezuela. How many innings in baseball? 10:07 p.m.: Similar to Major League Baseball, World Baseball Classic games are nine innings long. If teams are tied after nine innings, the 10th inning and beyond begins with a runner on second base.Article continues below this ad Top 7th: Venezuela threatens 10:02 p.m.: Will Vest works around Ezequiel Tovar's one-out single, retiring Wilyer Abreu on a groundout and Salvador Perez on a fly ball to right. We head to the bottom of the seventh with Team USA running out of time. Pete Crow-Armstrong in center field 9:58 p.m.: Pete Crow-Armstrong pinch hit for Byron Buxton in the bottom of the sixth and remains in the game as the center fielder.Article continues below this ad Will Vest replaces Brad Keller 9:55 p.m.: Will Vest replaces Brad Keller, who exits after pitching 1 1/3 innings without allowing any hits or runs, while striking out one batter. End 6th: Aaron Judge grounds out 9:52 p.m.: Aaron Judge works the count full, but grounds out to third for the final out of the sixth.Article continues below this ad Bryce Harper gets on base 9:49 p.m.: Bryce Harper hits a two-out single to right field, bringing up Aaron Judge, who represents the tying run. José Buttó replaces Eduard Bazardo 9:47 p.m.: José Buttó replaces Eduard Bazardo on the mound for Venezuela to start the bottom of the sixth inning.Article continues below this ad Top 6th: Brad Keller does his job 9:44 p.m.: Just what the doctor ordered as Brad Keller retires the side on seven pitches. Team USA is looking for a rally as we head to the bottom of the sixth with Venezuela leading 2-0. End 5th: Team USA shutout through five 9:39 p.m.: Eduard Bazardo strikes out Will Smith and gets Brice Turang to ground out to second as we head to the top of the sixth inning with Team USA trailing Venezuela 2-0. The U.S. has just one hit in the game.Article continues below this ad Eduard Bazardo replaces Eduardo Rodriguez 9:34 p.m.: Eduard Bazardo replaces Eduardo Rodriguez with one out in the bottom of the fifth. Top 5th: Venezuela 2, Team USA 0 9:30 p.m.: Ronald Acuna Jr. grounds out to end the top of the fifth. Team USA trails 2-0.Article continues below this ad Brad Keller replaces Nolan McLean 9:26 p.m.: With two outs in the top of the fifth inning, Brad Keller comes on to pitch to Ronald Acuna Jr. Nolan McLean's night is done. Wilyer Abreu homers 9:21 p.m.: Wilyer Abreu leads off the top of the fifth with a blast to center to put Venezuela up 2-0. Article continues below this ad End 4th: Venezuela 1, Team USA 0 9:19 p.m.: After Aaron Judge struck out for the second time in the game and Kyle Schwarber worked a two-out walk, Alex Bregman grounded into a forceout at second base to end the fourth. Eduardo Rodriguez strikes out Aaron Judge 9:14 p.m.: During the pregame show, Alex Rodriguez predicted that Aaron Judge would hit two home runs tonight. After two at-bats, Judge has two strikeouts. Article continues below this ad Top 4th: Nolan McLean retires side in order 9:11 p.m.: Nice bounce back inning from Nolan McLean as he gets a ground out, strike out and pop out to quickly retire the side in order. McLean has four strikeouts in the game. End 3th: Eduardo Rodriguez cruising 9:04 p.m.: Brice Turang gets a one-out single for Team USA's first hit of the game, but Eduardo Rodriguez strikes out Byron Buxton, and Bobby Witt Jr. flies out to center field to end the third. Venezuela leads 1-0.Article continues below this ad Top 3rd: Venezuela 1, Team USA 0 8:54 p.m.: Luis Arraez grounds out to second base to end the third inning, but Venezuela takes a 1-0 lead after Maikel Garcia's sacrifice fly scores Salvador Perez. Venezuela strikes first 8:52 p.m.: With runners on second and third and two outs, Maikel Garcia hits a sacrifice fly to center field to score the first run of the game as Venezuela takes a 1-0 lead.Article continues below this ad End 2nd: Team USA goes quietly 8:43 p.m.: Kyle Schwarber strikes out and Alex Bregman and Roman Anthony ground out as Team USA goes down quietly in the bottom of the second inning. Top 2nd: Nolan McLean strikes out 2 8:38 p.m.: Team USA starter Nolan McLean turns it up a notch in the top of the second inning, striking out Eugenio Suarez and Gleyber Torres before allowing a two-out single to Ezequiel Tovar. McLean then got Wilyer Abreu to pop out to short to end the inning.Article continues below this ad Mark DeRosa, Team USA manager 8:35 p.m.: Former MLB infielder Mark DeRosa has guided Team USA baseball to the WBC final by blending a strong clubhouse culture with All-Star talent. DeRosa, who played 16 seasons in the majors before becoming an analyst for MLB Network, has relied heavily on captain Aaron Judge and other stars to help set the tone. End 1st: Aaron Judge takes called 3rd strike 8:30 p.m.: Bobby Witt Jr. leads off with a long fly ball out to center, Bryce Harper pops out to shortstop and Aaron Judge takes a questionable called third strike to end the first scoreless.Article continues below this ad Top 1st: Nolan McLean faces minimum 8:25 p.m.: Ronald Acuna Jr. singles to lead off the top of the first, but Nolan McLean gets Maikel Garcia to ground into a double play and Luis Arraez flies out to center to end the inning. We head to the bottom of the first. Team USA vs. Venezuela underway 8:20 p.m.: Enough of the pomp and circumstance, let's play ball. Team USA pitcher Nolan McLean's first pitch is hit up the middle by Ronald Acuna Jr. for a single.Article continues below this ad Where is the World Baseball Classic being played? 8:15 p.m.: Tonight's World Baseball Classic final is being played at loanDepot Park in Miami, home of the Miami Marlins. Venezuela's star power 8:10 p.m.: Team Venezuela's top three batters have been impressive. Ronald Acuña Jr. has recorded three extra-base hits, driven in four runs, and boasts an OPS of .979. Maikel Garcia has also notched three extra-base hits, adding six RBIs and an OPS of 1.110. Luis Arraez comes into tonight's game with six extra-base hits, ten RBIs, and an impressive OPS of 1.167. Article continues below this ad Aaron Judge, Captain America 8 p.m.: Team USA captain Aaron Judge took part in an interview with former New York Yankee Derek Jeter, which aired on FOX prior to the start of the game. During the interview, Judge expressed what it means for him to represent Team USA on such a big stage."I thought about all the people who came before me and wore this uniform, those people who sacrificed for this country. ... It's a privilege to represent your country and compete in these environments. Now it's time to finish strong." World Baseball Classic predictions are in 7:56 p.m.: The "experts" have weighed in on their predictions for tonight's game. Here are the results.Article continues below this ad Derek Jeter: Team USA Alex Rodriguez: Team USA David Ortiz: Venezuela How good is Team USA baseball? 7:45 p.m.: We can settle on "pretty good." Aaron Judge, Bryce Harper, Kyle Schwarber, Paul Skenes, Bobby Witt Jr. ... shall we continue? Here is the combined resume of the roster for Manager Mark DeRosa. 13 Gold Gloves 11 top-30 draft picks 10 Silver Sluggers 9 World Series titles 7 MVP awards 6 Cy Young awards 5 Rookie of the Year awards Article continues below this ad Team USA jerseys 7:30 p.m.: Team USA arrived at loanDepot Park in Miami rocking Team USA jerseys. ... Team USA hockey jerseys, that is. The U.S. men's hockey team won a gold medal at the 2026 Milan Cortina Winter Olympics. Who is Eduardo Rodriguez? 7:24 p.m.: Venezuela's starting pitcher, Eduardo "E-Rod" Rodriguez, is a left-handed pitcher who currently plays for the Arizona Diamondbacks. He previously pitched for the Boston Red Sox from 2015 to 2021, where he was a member of the 2018 World Series championship team. Article continues below this ad What’s at stake? 7:15 p.m.: The winner will be crowned as the champion of the 2026 World Baseball Classic. Team USA won its only WBC championship in 2017, defeating Puerto Rico 8-0 in the final game. This will mark Venezuela's first appearance in a WBC title game. Who is pitching for Team USA? 7 p.m.: Nolan McLean, a 24-year-old right-handed pitcher from the New York Mets, will start for Team USA. McLean's previous WBC outing against Italy saw him allow three earned runs over three innings. McLean was selected by the New York Mets in the third round of the 2023 MLB Draft. In 2025, he appeared in 8 games for the Mets, posting a 5-1 record with a 2.06 ERA over 48 innings, during which he struck out 57 batters.Article continues below this ad Venezuela’s batting order 6:45 p.m.: Here's a look at Team Venezuela's lineup tonight.1. Ronald Acuña Jr., RF2. Maikel Garcia, 3B3. Luis Arraez, 1B4. Eugenio Suárez, DH5. Gleyber Torres, 2B6. Ezequiel Tovar, SS7. Wilyer Abreu, LF8. Salvador Perez, C9. Jackson Chourio, CFArticle continues below this ad6:30 p.m.: Team USA and Venezuela have faced each other five times in WBC play, with the U.S. holding a 3-2 lead. Team USA won the first matchup 15-6 in 2009 pool play, highlighted by home runs from Kevin Youkilis, Adam Dunn, and Ryan Braun. The most recent meeting ended in a 9-7 victory for Team USA in the 2023 quarterfinals.March 17, 2026|Updated March 18, 2026 12:57 a.m.Kyra Santicola joined the Times Union in November 2006 and served in various roles before becoming the newspaper’s Sports Editor in December 2024.
